pivHint: God DAILY bears our burdens, the psalmist writes. In the Lord's Prayer we ask, 'Give us this day our daily ______.'
winText: You found it. DAILY isn't just a word in today's verse — the Lord's Prayer asks for our daily BREAD.
lossText: The word was BREAD. DAILY was the pivot — the Lord's Prayer asks for our daily BREAD.
votdVerse: Praise be to the Lord, to God our Savior, who daily bears our burdens.
passageText: Praise be to the Lord, to God our Savior, who daily bears our burdens. “I removed the burden from their shoulders; their hands were set free from the basket. My guilt has overwhelmed me like a burden too heavy to bear.
